eager second son who's read the manuals and not yet bled. novice slayer task-giver.

the court wizard who outlived his court and forgot why. Barrows brother — magic specialist.

the desert nomad who knows the right wind to walk in. Boneyard guide, water-broker, sandstorm survival tutor.

the dream made of every artist who ever burned an unfinished page. boss — the Muse.

the last of a kind that does not believe it is the last. tier 5 endgame boss — the Last Dragon (Last Dragon Part 3).

the Crown's deniable problem-solver, who knows the names. Wilds bounty contracts, PvP target list.
the desert prince who is not, technically, a prince — and not, technically, alive. Boneyard mid-tier boss, faction figurehead of the desert nomads who do still travel.
the dream of a finished symphony. Inkweald endgame boss.
the Rider who took the slow road. mid-tier Boneyard boss, one of the Riders.
the pyromancer-priest who keeps the dead from forgetting they are dead. Spirit Pyre minigame coordinator, firemaking tutor (advanced).
the guardian who has held the door so long it forgets what is on the other side. Guardians of the Rift coordinator, runecrafting tutor.
the field commander who runs the only training ground that requires friendship. Barbarian Assault minigame coordinator, team-combat tutor.
the merchant-queen of a hub that nobody owns. Drifting Market faction leader, information broker, charter-keeper.
the former miner who runs the mine from a chair now. mining tutor (novice), Missing Miner quest-giver.
the retired court falconer whose loyalty is to the bird. hunter tutor (falconry), Royal Falconer quest-giver.
Aelgard's Wise Old Man — if the wise old man had, in fact, read the books. lore contact, quest context broker, reading tutor.
the dwarf everyone assumes is useless, who is the only one who remembers the deep tunnels correctly. eccentric, unofficial lore node, dwarven stout importer.
the innkeeper who remembers every face and pretends not to. social hub, rumour node, bed-and-board provider.
the thing Veldrak is guarding without knowing. tier 5 endgame boss (apex of the Glass Desert endgame chain).
the kitchen tyrant who is correct about soup. Culinaromancer's Curse boss, Grand Feast prestige encounter.
one half of a storm, still arguing with the other. Storm Twins boss (twin-phase), Saltbrine mid-tier encounter.
